'''Darth Arctis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] and [[Dark Council]] member during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
At one point during the Cold War, the forces of his fellow Councilor [[Darth Hadra]]&mdash;the head of the [[Sphere of Technology]] but also the ruler of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]&mdash;discovered an ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] shrine outside [[Kaas City]] and tried to claim it. Arctis quickly challenged Hadra's claim, saying that the shrine fell within the bounds of his [[Sphere of Ancient Knowledge]]'s influence. He then began to "negotiate" with Hadra for control of the shrine.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

After the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Skotia]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in [[Duel in the Sith Sanctum|suspicious circumstances]] and [[Darth Thanaton]] wished to punish [[Darth Zash]], the most likely perpetrator, Arctis sided against Thanaton and supported the Dark Council in raising Zash to Skotia's former position.<ref name="TOR" />

In [[3640 BBY]], Thanaton ascended to the Dark Council after Arctis' sudden death. No one knew how he died though most suspected that Thanaton, his immediate successor, was responsible.<ref name="TOR" />
